notes: Level 2 learns A tier 1, level 3 B tier 1, level 4 A tier 2, level 5 B tier 2. Each tier-1 pick has its own two tier-2 follow-ups. Mods: set/add/mul change the ability's numbers, fx turns on mechanics (see src/sim/talents.ts).

r.name: BLOODROAR
r.desc: WAR CRY BECOMES A BLOOD OATH: ALLIES IN 12M HEAL 18% OF ALL DAMAGE THEY DEAL WHILE IT LASTS.

r.name: CHALLENGE
r.desc: WAR CRY DRAGS EVERY FOE IN 6M TO YOU. FOR 3S THEY DEAL 20% LESS AND YOU TAKE 20% LESS.

b.name: MAGNITUDE
b.desc: SLAM SUCKS FOES INTO ITS CENTER AND TEARS OPEN A SINKHOLE THAT SLOWS 50%. RADIUS +15%.
b.combo: WITH CHALLENGE: THE SLAM ALSO STUNS 1S.

b.name: SHOULDER CHARGE
b.desc: SLAM BECOMES A 5M CHARGE THAT BOWLS FOES OVER FOR 45 AND STUNS 0.6S, THEN SLAMS. UNSTOPPABLE WHILE CHARGING.

a.name: EARTHSPLITTER
a.desc: YOUR FINISHER SPLITS THE GROUND: A ROCK WAVE RUNS 9M, STUNS 0.5S AND ERUPTS AT THE END FOR 45.

a.name: BERSERKER
a.desc: SWINGS HEAL 10% OF THEIR DAMAGE AND STACK ATTACK SPEED. AT 3 STACKS EVERY SWING CLEAVES ALL AROUND YOU.

z.name: CATACLYSM
z.desc: EARTHQUAKE+: 15% WIDER, STUNS 0.2S LONGER AND LEAVES A FIELD OF LAVA CRACKS FOR 4S.

r.name: TESLA TOWER
r.desc: YOUR SIEGE RAMP GETS A TESLA COIL ON TOP: 400 HP, CHAINS LIGHTNING THROUGH 3 FOES EVERY SECOND WHILE THE RAMP STANDS.

r.name: PALISADE
r.desc: SIEGE WORKS BECOME A SPIKED TIMBER WALL. IT SLAMS UP THROUGH FOES FOR 60, STUNS 0.6S AND LASTS 12S.

b.name: SHOCK WRENCH
b.desc: THE PULSE ELECTRIFIES: 90 TO FOES, STUN 0.5S, AND A TESLA FIELD CRACKLES FOR 4S. REACH +20%.
b.combo: WITH TESLA TOWER: REPAIRED TOWERS AND COILS FIRE TWICE AS FAST FOR 6S.

b.name: FORTIFY
b.desc: REPAIRS ALSO BOLT ON ARMOR: BUILDINGS GET A 250 SHIELD, YOU AND TROOPS NEARBY GET 90. REACH +30%.
b.combo: WITH PALISADE: REPAIRS ADD 6S TO YOUR WALLS.

a.name: RIVETER
a.desc: YOUR FINISHER FIRES A FAN OF THREE HOT RIVETS 10M THAT BURST FOR 30 AROUND WHAT THEY HIT.

a.name: OVERCLOCK
a.desc: HITS CUT REPAIR COOLDOWN 0.6S AND STACK ATTACK SPEED. AT 4 STACKS EVERY HIT ARCS LIGHTNING TO 2 FOES FOR 35.

z.name: GREAT BALLISTA
z.desc: BALLISTA+: 60% MORE HP, BOLTS HIT 30% HARDER, +3M RANGE AND IT STANDS 10S LONGER.

r.name: SMOKE BOMB
r.desc: STEALTH DROPS A CHOKING SMOKE CLOUD 3.5M WIDE: FOES INSIDE ARE SLOWED 45% FOR 4S.

r.name: SHADOW STEP
r.desc: STEALTH BECOMES A BLINK: VANISH AND REAPPEAR UP TO 7M AWAY (HOLD TO AIM), UNSEEN FOR 1.5S.

b.name: POUNCE
b.desc: LEAP LANDINGS MARK FOES: THEY TAKE 30% MORE FROM YOU AND THE MARK RIPS FOR 90 AFTER 2S.
b.combo: WITH SMOKE BOMB: MARKS TAKE 50% MORE.

b.name: DOUBLE JUMP
b.desc: LEAP AGAIN WITHIN 3S. LANDINGS CRATER THE GROUND, SLOWING FOES 45%.
b.combo: WITH SHADOW STEP: BLINKING RESETS LEAP.

a.name: SERRATED
a.desc: HITS BLEED 14/S (3 STACKS). YOUR FINISHER ON A 3-STACK RIPS IT OPEN FOR 100. HEAL 25% OF DAMAGE TO BLEEDERS.

a.name: TWIN FANGS
a.desc: YOUR FINISHER THROWS TWO POISONED DAGGERS 8M THAT SLOW 40% AND RICOCHET TO ANOTHER FOE.

z.name: DEATH MARK
z.desc: EXECUTE DASH+: +3M, EXECUTES BELOW 50% HEALTH AND A HERO KILL REFUNDS 60% OF YOUR METER.

r.name: RISEN RANKS
r.desc: SOLDIERS FROM AN OUTPOST YOU EMPOWER COME OUT AS VETERANS.

r.name: WRAITH GATE
r.desc: GRAVEWALK CHANNELS IN 0.6S. YOU ARRIVE IN A BURST OF WRAITHS: FOES IN 5M TAKE 60, ARE HEXED AND SLOWED 50% FOR 2S. YOU GAIN A 120 SHIELD.

b.name: GRAVE PULL
b.desc: HEX DRAGS FOES INTO ITS CENTER AND LEAVES BONE SPIKES FOR 3S (SLOW 40%, 25/S).
b.combo: WITH WRAITH GATE: HEXED FOES ARE ALSO STUNNED 1S.

b.name: CASCADE
b.desc: HEX FALLS THREE TIMES, MARCHING FORWARD 3M EACH TIME.
b.combo: WITH RISEN RANKS: EVERY HEX RAISES A GRUNT FOR 12S.

a.name: SOUL SIPHON
a.desc: BOLTS HEAL YOU FOR 30% OF THEIR DAMAGE AND GROW A SOUL SHIELD, +25 EACH UP TO 150.

a.name: ARC BOLTS
a.desc: BOLTS LEAP TO TWO MORE FOES FOR 60%. YOUR ORB ARCS TO THREE MORE.

z.name: LEGION
z.desc: RAISE AN ARMY+: TWO MORE GRUNTS AND ONE MORE ARCHER, 10S LONGER, AND THE HEX REACHES 3M FURTHER.

r.name: RIPOSTE
r.desc: PARRY WINDOW +0.2S. A CLEAN PARRY GRANTS A 150 SHIELD AND THE COUNTER HITS TWICE AS HARD, STUNNING 0.6S LONGER.

r.name: VOLTE
r.desc: PARRY BECOMES A SIDESTEP: BLINK 4M (HOLD TO AIM), UNTOUCHABLE, AND YOUR NEXT A HITS 70% HARDER.

b.name: BLINK STEP
b.desc: LUNGE AGAIN WITHIN 2.5S, AND A PHANTOM REPEATS EACH LUNGE HALF A SECOND LATER.

b.name: MARKED
b.desc: LUNGE MARKS FOES FOR 4S: THEY TAKE 25% MORE FROM YOUR WHOLE TEAM AND DEAL 25% LESS.
b.combo: WITH RIPOSTE: PARRIED ATTACKERS ARE MARKED TOO.

a.name: FLECHE
a.desc: YOUR FINISHER LUNGES FARTHER, HITS 40% HARDER AND SENDS A SLASH 7M THROUGH FOES FOR 45.

a.name: MOMENTUM
a.desc: HITS STACK +8% DAMAGE AND ATTACK SPEED UP TO 5, AND CUT YOUR R COOLDOWN 0.8S.

z.name: THOUSAND CUTS
z.desc: BLADE FLURRY+: THREE MORE STRIKES, EACH HITTING HARDER, AND 60% MORE DAMAGE TO STUNNED FOES.

r.name: ROOT CAGE
r.desc: STONE WALL BECOMES A ROOT CAGE: AFTER 0.5S ROOTS BURST UP WHERE YOU AIM (UP TO 9M), DEALING 60 AND HOLDING FOES 1.4S.

r.name: LIVING RAMPART
r.desc: THE WALL GROWS 3M LONGER, LASTS 4S MORE AND SPROUTS A GROVE: ALLIES BESIDE IT HEAL 30 PER SECOND.

b.name: GRASPING VINE
b.desc: THE SLAP YANKS ITS TARGET TO YOU AND CHOKES IT, STUNNING 0.8S.
b.combo: WITH ROOT CAGE: YANKING A ROOTED FOE DEALS +60.

b.name: WHIPLASH
b.desc: THE SLAP HITS EVERYONE IN LINE, REACHES 3M FARTHER AND BURSTS INTO SPLINTERS AT ITS END FOR 55.
b.combo: WITH LIVING RAMPART: THE LASH ALSO STUNS 0.8S.

a.name: THORNGUARD
a.desc: HITS GROW A BARK SHIELD, +25 EACH UP TO 150. WHILE IT HOLDS YOU TAKE 25% LESS, AND WHEN IT BREAKS IT BURSTS FOR 90.

a.name: OVERGROWTH
a.desc: YOUR FINISHER ROOTS FOES 0.6S AND LEAVES A PATCH OF BRAMBLES FOR 3S.

z.name: ANCIENT GROVE
z.desc: BRAMBLES+: 2M WIDER, 3S LONGER, AND ALLIES INSIDE HEAL 25 PER SECOND.

r.name: FIRE ARROWS
r.desc: VOLLEY ARROWS ARE LIT: THE GROUND THEY HIT BURNS FOR 3S (25 PER SECOND, SLOWS) AND THE RAIN SPREADS 0.5M WIDER.

r.name: DOUBLE VOLLEY
r.desc: A SECOND RAIN OF ARROWS FALLS ON THE SAME SPOT RIGHT AFTER THE FIRST, AT 80% STRENGTH.

b.name: LONG WATCH
b.desc: PIP HOLDS ON FOR 8S INSTEAD OF 5 AND ITS MARK MAKES THE TARGET TAKE 25% MORE FROM YOU.
b.combo: WITH DOUBLE VOLLEY: PIP'S PREY IS ALSO SLOWED 30% WHILE PIP HANGS ON.

b.name: RAKING TALONS
b.desc: PIP PECKS ON ITS OWN EVERY SECOND, AND EVERY PECK OPENS A BLEED THAT STACKS 3 TIMES.
b.combo: WITH FIRE ARROWS: PECKS HIT 8 HARDER.

a.name: BROADHEAD
a.desc: ARROWS BURST ON IMPACT FOR 18 AROUND THE TARGET (2M). FULL POWER SHOTS FLY 4M FARTHER.

a.name: QUICKDRAW
a.desc: YOU LOOSE 20% FASTER, AND EVERY ARROW THAT HITS A CHAMPION TAKES 1S OFF SEND PIP.

z.name: HUNTER'S MARK
z.desc: HEARTSEEKER+: EVERYTHING IT HITS IS MARKED FOR 6S (YOUR WHOLE HOUSE DEALS 20% MORE TO THEM) AND PIP FLIES TO THE CHAMPION IF IT'S ON YOUR SHOULDER.

r.name: CLUSTER KEG
r.desc: THE POWDER KEG BURSTS INTO THREE LITTLE KEGS THAT HOP OUTWARD AND POP FOR 40 EACH.

r.name: TAR KEG
r.desc: THE BLAST LEAVES A POOL OF BURNING TAR FOR 3.5S: FOES IN IT ARE SLOWED 50% AND TAKE 18 PER SECOND.

b.name: HEARTY STOUT
b.desc: THE SPLASH ALSO GIVES EVERY ALLY IT TOUCHES AN 80 SHIELD FOR 5S.
b.combo: WITH CLUSTER KEG: THE HEALING KEG SPLITS TOO, TWO LITTLE KEGS HEAL 40 WHERE THEY LAND.

b.name: WELLSPRING
b.desc: THE ALE PUDDLE IS 1M WIDER, LASTS 8S AND ALLIES STANDING IN IT MOVE 15% FASTER.
b.combo: WITH TAR KEG: FOES WADING IN YOUR PUDDLE ARE SLOWED 30%.

a.name: TAPROOM BRAWLER
a.desc: YOUR SWINGS HEAL YOU FOR 15% OF THEIR DAMAGE AND PATCH UP SOLDIERS AROUND YOU FOR 25 A HIT.

a.name: BELLY FLOP
a.desc: YOUR FINISHER IS A FULL BELLY FLOP: 35% HARDER, KNOCKS FOES FARTHER AND STUNS THEM 0.6S.

z.name: GRAND CASK
z.desc: BREWFEST+: THE CASK HOLDS 14S, POURS 2M WIDER AND HAS 900 HEALTH.
